Flow.description: Portal flow (Screen Flow: Individual Application Reciprocity). The reciprocity application on the portal, matching the Board's packets: Regular (Cosmetology, Esthetician, Manicurist or Instructor), Military and Foreign. The applicant picks the application and discipline, confirms their details, lists schools and the licenses they hold elsewhere, and answers the form's questions. For Regular, the exams come from the state tables (Reciprocity State Exams and Eligibility Reciprocity) using the license with the earliest initial date; Military takes the state exam and Foreign takes all three. Nothing is written to Individual Application until the applicant certifies: the form keeps a draft (Preliminary Application Reference) for documents and can be saved for later for 30 days. On certifying it creates the submitted application and its fees, moves the documents across and goes to payment. Runs in system context; it only uses the signed-in applicant's own records. Staff can also enter it for an applicant from New Application on the Person Account (input recordId); the pay step then tells them to record the payment.

formulas.description: True when staff are entering the form for an applicant (from New Application).

formulas.name: forT_Path
formulas.description: The application path (Regular, Military or International). A choice field can come through as its value or its label in a formula, so both are accepted.
formulas.expression: IF(OR({!AC_Path} = "International", {!AC_Path} = "Foreign Reciprocity: I am licensed outside the United States"), "International", IF(OR({!AC_Path} = "Military", {!AC_Path} = "Reciprocity - Military"), "Military", "Regular"))

formulas.name: forT_Discipline
formulas.description: The license type name applied for (Cosmetologist, Esthetician, Manicurist or Instructor), from the choice's value or label.

formulas.name: forT_LicenseTypeName
formulas.description: The license type to look up: the instructor license chosen when the answer is Instructor, otherwise the license itself.

formulas.name: forT_MatrixDiscipline
formulas.description: The discipline as the state tables name it.

formulas.name: forB_AskGender
formulas.description: The military form does not ask for gender.

formulas.name: forT_SchoolHeading
formulas.description: As printed on each form.
formulas.expression: IF({!forB_IsForeign}, "Name of the school attended", IF({!forB_IsMilitary}, "School name where training was acquired", "State where training was acquired"))

formulas.name: forT_RegularExams
formulas.description: The exams from the state table, as the Exams field stores them.

formulas.name: forT_Exams
formulas.description: Foreign takes all three, Military the state exam, Regular what the state table says (blank when the office decides).

formulas.name: forT_SubmittedExamText
formulas.description: The exam line on the closing screen: military applicants take only the state exam.
formulas.expression: IF({!forB_IsMilitary}, "You'll receive your state examination date by mail.", "You'll receive your national testing information by email, if you need the national exam, and your practical and state examination dates by mail.")

formulas.name: forT_ExamList
formulas.expression:
IF(ISBLANK({!forT_Exams}), "", "
    " & IF(CONTAINS(";" & {!forT_Exams}, "State"), "
  • The Louisiana state exam (laws and rules)
    • ", "") & IF({!forB_TakesNational}, "
  • The national (NIC) exam
    • ", "") & IF({!forB_TakesPractical}, "
  • The hands-on practical exam
    • ", "") & "
")

formulas.name: forT_Attestation
formulas.description: The Foreign forms print no certification wording.
formulas.expression: IF({!forB_IsForeign}, "", "By signing this application, I certify that the information provided above is true and accurate under penalty of perjury. I also certify that I am aware that it is a violation of the Louisiana Cosmetology Laws for an individual to work without a valid Louisiana cosmetologist, manicurist, esthetician or instructor license.")

formulas.name: forB_LicenseByApprenticeship
formulas.description: The applicant got the license by apprenticeship, experience or online training, not at a school: the license cannot transfer.

formulas.name: forB_NonTransferableLicenseType
formulas.description: The applicant says the license is one of the types the Board does not accept from any state.

formulas.name: forT_StaffNote
formulas.expression: IF(AND(NOT({!forB_IsMilitary}), NOT({!forB_IsForeign}), {!RunEligibilityReciprocity.NeedsBoardReview}), "The state table says to contact the office for this license (" & BLANKVALUE({!varT_OriginatingState}, "no out-of-state license given") & "). Staff to set the exams.", "")

formulas.name: forT_FeeNameForeignFeeItem
formulas.description: $75 with a Louisiana driver's license or state ID, $100 without.

formulas.name: forT_InitialFeeName
formulas.description: Which Fee Schedule row prices this fee: the license type's name followed by Initial, such as Cosmetologist Initial.

formulas.name: forN_InitialAmount
formulas.description: The fee amount: the license type's row, or the generic Individual License row when the type has none.

formulas.name: forT_InitialFeeCode
formulas.description: The fee code from whichever Fee Schedule row priced the fee.
